_comment: Dockerfiles can't express runtime flags like --privileged or -v /var/run/docker.sock. This file lets run_evaluation.py simulate the true run profile described in each Dockerfile's header comment, without requiring you to actually launch a privileged container to grade this project. Delete an entry to fall back to pure static Dockerfile analysis for that image.

notes: Simulated run profile: docker run --privileged --user root -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock --network host
Full host device and kernel access via --privileged.
Docker socket mount grants effective root on the HOST, not just the container.
